test_configuration.BFB_MACOS_PROFILE: Matching development-only Mac profile for the BFB App ID, existing developer certificate and test Mac; private local path omitted.
test_configuration.terminal_automation: Timo reported permission allowed and Terminal started before the final passing run.

native_observations.ui_review: Actual first-run status window, recovery, scrolling and keyboard focus reviewed; resulting copy-only corrections compiled and tested at the certified revision.
native_observations.consent_interruption: An intermediate run at the certified revision timed out with Apple Event -1712 and reported app_delivery_unknown. It was not counted as passing or retried as a business action. After Timo reported allowing access and starting Terminal, the exact gate passed.
native_observations.os_dialog_cause: Not independently observed; automated access to the protected Terminal/system dialog UI was unavailable.

not_claimed: Public AASA/CDN Universal Link discovery; the managed test directs the HTTPS URL to the signed app
Notarization, release upgrades or genuinely fresh macOS account certification (G02)
Whole-machine sleep, cross-device reachability or a running complete local MVP
Durable single-use Terminal intent consumption or real provider execution (L05/L07/P01)
Actual notification authorization, user-visible notification delivery or domain action routing (X01)
A new physical locked-session run at the certified revision; current unit tests cover locked/login-window behavior and earlier signed diagnostics observed the locked state
retention: Bounded synthetic assertions and public protocol fixtures only. No raw logs, Terminal transcript, credentials, profile contents, hardware identifiers, personal task data or local absolute paths are retained.
